mapper.sql: id, application_id, environment_id, name, status, current_draft_version, latest_version, (select a.name from application a where a.id = rule.application_id) as application_name, (select lower(coalesce(e.type, e.name)) from environment e where e.id = rule.environment_id) as environment_name, (select concat(rt.class_name, '#', rt.method_name) from rule_target rt join rule_version rv on rv.id = rt.rule_version_id where rv.rule_id = rule.id and rv.status = 'ENABLED' order by rv.version desc, rt.created_at, rt.id limit 1) as target_method, (select rv.status from rule_version rv where rv.rule_id = rule.id and rv.version = rule.latest_version limit 1) as latest_version_status, (select count(*) from rule_version rv where rv.rule_id = rule.id) as version_count, (select count(*) from rule_version rv where rv.rule_id = rule.id and rv.status = 'ENABLED') as enabled_version_count, (select count(*) from rule_version rv where rv.rule_id = rule.id and rv.status = 'DISABLED') as disabled_version_count, (select rrs.rule_version from rule_runtime_status rrs join rule_version rv on rv.rule_id = rrs.rule_id and rv.version = rrs.rule_version where rrs.rule_id = rule.id and rrs.status = 'ACTIVE' and rv.status = 'ENABLED' order by rrs.updated_at desc, rrs.rule_version desc limit 1) as online_version, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at

sql.if: where lower(coalesce(name, '')) like concat('%', #{query}, '%') or lower(coalesce(application_id, '')) like concat('%', #{query}, '%') or lower(coalesce(environment_id, '')) like concat('%', #{query}, '%') or lower(coalesce((select a.name from application a where a.id = rule.application_id), '')) like concat('%', #{query}, '%') or lower(coalesce((select coalesce(e.type, e.name) from environment e where e.id = rule.environment_id), '')) like concat('%', #{query}, '%')

mapper.select:
select from rule
order by updated_at desc, id limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select * from rule_version where rule_id = #{ruleId} order by version desc
select rt.* from rule_target rt join rule_version rv on rv.id = rt.rule_version_id where rv.rule_id = #{ruleId} order by rv.version desc, rt.created_at, rt.id
select rc.* from rule_capability rc join rule_version rv on rv.id = rc.rule_version_id where rv.rule_id = #{ruleId} order by rv.version desc, rc.capability
